findings.current: It was bad enough that he’d given himself a title that didn’t suit his appearance at all: Demon Bird.
findings.defect: Turns the self-chosen title into another grievance rather than a response to his hated old title.
findings.rationale: 오죽하면 presents his choice as evidence of just how much the old title bothered him.
findings.replacement: Why else would he have given himself the title Demon Bird, a name that didn’t suit his appearance at all?
findings.source: 오죽하면 외관과는 영 어울리지도 않는, 마조(魔鳥)라는 별호를 스스로 지었겠나.

findings.current: And those were the last expressions they ever made.
findings.defect: Narrows their last appearance to their facial expressions.
findings.rationale: 마지막 모습 refers to the two Keshik as last seen, not specifically to their expressions.
findings.replacement: And that was the last anyone saw of them alive.

findings.defect: Drops the ordinal in Wipeng’s address to Jin Mukyung.
findings.rationale: 이 공자 identifies the second young master; the supplied address ledger also preserves that distinction.

findings.current: Fist Energy shot from the rotating punch and swept toward his master’s killer.
findings.defect: Changes an apparent engulfing hit into an attack merely traveling toward its target.
findings.rationale: 휩쓸었다 describes the energy sweeping over him; the next sentence retracts that apparent result.
findings.replacement: Fist Energy shot from his spinning fist and engulfed his master’s killer.
findings.source: 회전을 가미하여 쏘아진 주먹 끝에서 뻗어 나간 권기(拳氣)가 스승의 원수를 휩쓸었다.

findings.current: The Demon Bird grunted as the tremendous recoil sent Wipeng flying. Without a moment’s hesitation, he shot his massive frame toward him.
findings.defect: Assigns the groan to the Demon Bird instead of Wipeng.
findings.rationale: The phrase 신음을 흘리며 튕겨 나가는 describes Wipeng, whom the Demon Bird then pursues.
findings.replacement: Wipeng groaned as the tremendous recoil sent him flying. The Demon Bird shot his massive frame toward him.
findings.source: 마조는 막강한 반발력에 의해 신음을 흘리며 튕겨 나가는 위팽을 향해 비대한 신형을 내쏘았다.

findings.current: Blood mixed with pieces of his innards poured from between the Demon Bird’s split lips.
findings.defect: Assigns the bleeding and internal injury to the Demon Bird, rather than to the two men struggling to withstand his Force.
findings.rationale: The following sentence has the two defenders bare their bloodied teeth at the Demon Bird, who is frozen in surprise; their injuries are also developed in the ensuing action.
findings.replacement: Blood mixed with bits of their innards poured from Cheol Mubaek’s and Wipeng’s split lips.
findings.source:
갈라진 입술 사이로 내장 조각이 섞인 핏물이 쏟아진다.

당혹스러운 눈빛으로 굳어 버린 마조를 향해, 철무백과 위팽은 피에 젖은 이빨을 드러내며 웃었다.

findings.current: And yet it was in the hands of two Peak masters from the provincial outskirts of Shanxi.
findings.defect: Places the masters on Shanxi’s outskirts instead of describing Shanxi Province itself as remote.
findings.rationale: 변방에 속한 modifies 산서성, not a location within Shanxi.
findings.replacement: And yet such weapons were in the hands of two Peak masters from remote Shanxi Province.
findings.source: 변방에 속한 산서성의 두 절정 고수의 손에 들려 있을 줄은.

findings.current: Cheol Mubaek clamped both hands around the short sword he’d been slowly pushing away from his gauntlets, gripping the Force that covered its short blade.
findings.defect: Reverses which combatant’s weapon is being forced back: the short sword is pushing Cheol Mubaek’s gauntlet back.
findings.rationale: 권갑을 밀어 내던 describes the short sword’s action against his gauntlet.
findings.replacement: Cheol Mubaek seized the short sword that had been slowly forcing his gauntlet back, gripping the Force shrouding its short blade.
findings.source: 철무백이 서서히 권갑을 밀어 내던 소검을, 그 짧은 검신을 뒤덮은 강기를 움켜잡았다.

findings.current: And he waited for someone to end the bastard’s life in place of his useless Disciple.
findings.defect: Makes the unworthy Disciple sound like someone else’s, obscuring Cheol Mubaek’s self-reproach.
findings.rationale: Cheol Mubaek is the master’s disciple and is waiting for another person to finish the fight in his place.
findings.replacement: And he waited for someone to kill the bastard in his stead, doing what he, an unworthy Disciple, could not.
findings.source: 또한 못난 제자를 대신하여 놈의 숨통을 끊어 줄 누군가를 기다리며.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it reverses two combat actions and assigns a serious injury to the wrong character. Several smaller changes affect causality, address, and geography.
